title: Al-Insan 76:1-5 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 39 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Insan 76:1-5 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 39. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا (١) إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا (٢) إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا (٣) إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا (٤) إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا (٥)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Idgham with ghunnah: tanween into م
Izhar shafawi; then ikhfa' (noon before ش)
The final alif is silent when joined; at a stop, silsilaa or silsil

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Insan 76:1-5 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 76:1-5 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 76:1-5 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.
Allah made the right path clear; each person chooses gratitude or ingratitude.

questions.q: Why does the mushaf write «سَلَٰسِلَا۟» with a small circle on the alif?
questions.a: It marks an alif that is written but not read when joining; it may be read at a stop.

questions.q: 76:3 says Allah showed man the way, whether he is ...
questions.a: A) grateful or ungrateful. 76:3: 'be he grateful or be he ungrateful.'

questions.q: Al-Insan 76:3: «إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: 'Has there come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing even mentioned?' (76:1). What does it feel like to think about a time before you existed?
questions.a: Humbling: Allah created us from nothing and gave us hearing and sight; everything we have is His gift.
